resolutions.Write: The unchanged example advertises MyESP32 without a service UUID. Require the UUID in actual GATT discovery, and check the advertised name separately. Guest onWrite and readback passed in the initial run.
resolutions.C3 Scan: Initial task drained command-complete and both scan reports before yielding; the unchanged sketch returned Devices found: 0. Yielding one tick after each received packet lets the host finish scan-enable. Final runs find one device.

other_errors.error: BLE controller BSS is too small or outside DRAM
other_errors.resolution: Classic reserved 2048 bytes; S3/C3 have 692/704. Use 512 bytes for bounded H4 packets.

other_errors.command: S3 Server --ble startup after buffer correction
other_errors.resolution: NimBLE does not link that function. The hook is optional; required VHCI hooks remain mandatory.

other_errors.error: BLE controller init has no room for the guest task trampoline
other_errors.resolution: Function entry 0x4201d45e is halfword-aligned. Align the trampoline/literals within validated function bounds and retain the original hook address.
Use explicit section offsets and NOP padding. CPU execution tests verify the bytes.
